in_marathi.name: Chhagan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chhagan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chhagan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Chhaya', which means shadow or shelter. The name Chhagan is associated with the Hindu god of fortune and prosperity, Lord Kubera. It is believed that a child named Chhagan will be blessed with wealth, happiness, and success in life.
